description: This Java source file defines the ProductFeatureServices class, providing service methods for managing product features, variants, and categories within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ProductFeatureServices
classes.description: Contains static service methods for handling product features, variants, and categories in OFBiz.

methods.name: getProductFeaturesByType
methods.description: Retrieves product features grouped by type based on provided category, group, or product ID, with optional filtering by application type.

methods.name: getAllExistingVariants
methods.description: Finds all product variants that match a given set of features for a specific product.

methods.name: getVariantCombinations
methods.description: Generates all possible variant combinations for a product based on its features, including existing variants.

methods.name: getCategoryVariantProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products within a category that match specified features, including their variants.
